definition: The force per unit current per unit length on a straight wire at right angles to a magnetic field, $B = \frac{F}{IL}$; a vector quantity measured in tesla, where $1\ \text{T} = 1\ \text{N A}^{-1}\,\text{m}^{-1}$.

A way to find the direction of the magnetic force: with the right hand flat, fingers along the field and thumb along the velocity of a positive charge or the current, the force comes out of the palm; for a negative charge the force is reversed.
